name: voltlank
description: VoltLink — self-hosted connected-vehicle platform: vehicle telemetry, secure controls, drives, charging, battery analytics, automations, notifications, fleet management, and a full status platform.
author: Atvriders

scripts.build: npm -w @voltlink/shared run build && npm -w @voltlink/api run build && npm -w @voltlink/web run build
scripts.test: npm -w @voltlink/shared run test && npm -w @voltlink/api run test && npm -w @voltlink/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @voltlink/shared run typecheck && npm -w @voltlink/api run typecheck && npm -w @voltlink/web run typecheck
